en.t: Emperor Hadrian of Rome dies of heart failure at his residence on the bay of Naples, Baiae; he is buried at Rome in the Tomb of Hadrian beside his late wife, Vibia Sabina
en.s: Hadrian ( HAY-dree-ən; born Publius Aelius Hadrianus, 24 January 76 – 10 July 138) was Roman emperor from 117 to 138. His form of address as Roman emperor was Imperator Caesar Traianus Hadrianus Augustus. Hadrian was born in Italica, in the present-day Andalusian province of Seville in southern Spain, an Italic settlement in Hispania Baetica; his gens Aelia came from the town of Hadria in central Italy.

zh.t: 罗马皇帝哈德良在那不勒斯湾的拜亚埃住所因心力衰竭去世，后与亡妻维比娅·萨比娜一同葬于罗马的哈德良陵墓
zh.s: 哈德良（读作 HAY-dree-ən；原名普布利乌斯·埃利乌斯·哈德里亚努斯；公元76年1月24日—138年7月10日）于117年至138年担任罗马皇帝。其正式尊号为“皇帝凯撒·图拉真·哈德良·奥古斯都”。哈德良出生于伊比利亚的意大利卡，当时属于西班牙南部安达卢西亚的塞维利亚省，是贝提卡行省的一座意大利殖民城；他的埃利乌斯氏族来自意大利中部哈德里亚镇。

en.t: Having usurped the throne of Emperor Gong of Jin, Liu Yu proclaims himself Emperor of the Liu Song dynasty
en.s: Emperor Gong of Jin (simplified Chinese: 晋恭帝; traditional Chinese: 晉恭帝; pinyin: Jìn Gōng Dì; Wade–Giles: Chin Kung-ti; 386 – October or November 421), personal name Sima Dewen (Chinese: 司馬德文; pinyin: Sīmǎ Déwén), was the last emperor of the Eastern Jin Dynasty (266–420) in China. He became emperor in January 419 after his developmentally disabled brother Emperor An was killed by the regent Liu Yu, and during his brief reign, actual power was in Liu Yu's hands.

zh.t: 刘裕篡夺晋恭帝的皇位，自立为刘宋皇帝
zh.s: 晋恭帝（简体中文：晋恭帝；繁体中文：晉恭帝；拼音：Jìn Gōng Dì；威妥玛拼音：Chin Kung-ti；386年—421年10月或11月），名司马德文，是中国东晋（266—420年）最后一位皇帝。他的发育迟缓的兄长晋安帝被摄政刘裕杀害后，他于419年1月继位。在他短暂的统治期间，实际权力掌握在刘裕手中。

en.t: Isshi Incident: Prince Naka-no-Ōe and Fujiwara no Kamatari assassinate Soga no Iruka during a coup d'état at the imperial palace
en.s: The Isshi incident (Japanese: 乙巳の変, Hepburn: Isshi no Hen) was a successful plot by Nakatomi no Kamatari (Fujiwara no Kamatari), Prince Naka no Ōe and others who conspired to eliminate the main branch of the Soga clan, beginning with the assassination of Soga no Iruka. It takes its name from the zodiological name of the year 645 during which the Taika Reform, a transformative event in Japanese Imperial history, occurred.

zh.t: 乙巳之变：中大兄皇子与藤原镰足在宫中发动政变，刺杀苏我入鹿
zh.s: 乙巳之变（日语：乙巳の変）是中臣镰足（藤原镰足）、中大兄皇子等人策划并成功实施的一场政变，他们试图铲除苏我氏本宗，行动首先是刺杀苏我入鹿。事件名称取自645年的干支年号；大化改新这一日本皇室历史上的重大变革也发生于这一年。

en.t: Ladislaus IV, King of Hungary, is assassinated at the castle of Körösszeg (modern-day Cheresig in Romania)
en.s: The King of Hungary (Hungarian: Magyarország királya) was the ruling head of state of the Kingdom of Hungary from 1000 (or 1001) to 1918. The style of title "Apostolic King of Hungary" (Magyarország apostoli királya) was endorsed by Pope Clement XIII in 1758 and used afterwards by all monarchs of Hungary.

zh.t: 匈牙利国王拉斯洛四世在克勒瑟格城堡遇刺身亡（今属罗马尼亚切雷西格）
zh.s: 匈牙利国王是匈牙利王国从1000年（或1001年）至1918年的统治者和国家元首。教皇克莱孟十三世于1758年认可“匈牙利宗座国王”（Magyarország apostoli királya）这一尊号，此后由匈牙利历代君主使用。

en.s: In 1301, Alauddin Khalji, the ruler of the Delhi Sultanate in India, conquered the neighbouring kingdom of Ranastambhapura (modern Ranthambore). Hammira, the Chahamana (Chauhan) king of Ranthambore, had granted asylum to some Mongol rebels from Delhi in 1299. He refused requests to either kill these rebels or hand them over to Alauddin, resulting in an invasion from Delhi.

zh.t: 阿劳丁·哈吉征服兰塔姆博尔
zh.s: 1301年，印度德里苏丹国统治者阿劳丁·哈吉征服了邻近的拉纳斯坦巴普拉王国（今兰塔姆博尔）。兰塔姆博尔的查哈马纳（乔汉）国王哈米尔曾于1299年收留一些从德里逃出的蒙古叛军。面对阿劳丁要求处死或交出这些叛军的命令，哈米尔都予以拒绝，德里方面因此发兵入侵。

en.s: The Battle of Northampton was fought on 10 July 1460 near the River Nene, Northamptonshire. It was a major battle of the Wars of the Roses. The opposing forces were an army led by nobles loyal to the King Henry VI of the House of Lancaster, his Queen Margaret of Anjou and their seven-year-old son Edward, Prince of Wales on one side, and the army of Edward, Earl of March and Warwick the Kingmaker on the other.

zh.s: 北安普敦战役于1460年7月10日在北安普敦郡内内河附近爆发，是玫瑰战争中的一场重要战役。一方是效忠兰开斯特王朝国王亨利六世的贵族所率军队，国王的王后安茹的玛格丽特和他们7岁的儿子威尔士亲王爱德华也在这一方；另一方是三月伯爵爱德华和“造王者”沃里克率领的军队。

en.s: The Prince of Ning rebellion was a revolt during the Ming dynasty in China led by Zhu Chenhao, Prince of Ning, against the reigning Zhengde Emperor. It took place in northern Jiangxi and southwestern Nanzhili (present-day northern Jiangxi and southern Anhui) and lasted from 10 July to 20 August 1519. The rebellion was ultimately quelled when the government army, led by Wang Yangming, the grand coordinator of southern Jiangxi, captured the Prince of Ning.
en.n: Zhu Chenhao declares the Ming dynasty's Zhengde Emperor a usurper, beginning the Prince of Ning rebellion, and leads his army north in an attempt to capture Nanjing.

zh.s: 宁王之乱是明朝时期由宁王朱宸濠发起、反抗当时在位的正德皇帝的一场叛乱。叛乱发生在江西北部和南直隶西南部（今江西北部和安徽南部），从1519年7月10日持续至8月20日。最终，江西南部巡抚王阳明率领官军俘获宁王，平定了叛乱。
zh.n: 朱宸濠宣布正德皇帝是篡位者，发动宁王之乱，并率军北上，企图攻占南京。

en.s: The Schmalkaldic War (German: Schmalkaldischer Krieg; July 1546 – May 1547) was fought within the territories of the Holy Roman Empire between the allied forces of Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor and Maurice, Duke of Saxony against the Lutheran Schmalkaldic League, with the forces directly loyal to Charles fighting under the command of Fernando Álvarez de Toledo, 3rd Duke of Alba.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 施马尔卡尔登战争（德语：Schmalkaldischer Krieg）于1546年7月至1547年5月在神圣罗马帝国境内进行。神圣罗马皇帝查理五世和萨克森公爵莫里茨结盟，对抗信义宗施马尔卡尔登联盟。直接效忠查理五世的军队由第三代阿尔瓦公爵费尔南多·阿尔瓦雷斯·德·托莱多指挥。

en.t: William I of Orange is assassinated in his home in Delft, Holland, by Balthasar Gérard
en.s: William the Silent or William the Taciturn (Dutch: Willem de Zwijger; 24 April 1533 – 10 July 1584), more commonly known in the Netherlands as William of Orange (Dutch: Willem van Oranje) and in the Dutch national anthem as William of Nassau (Dutch: Willem van Nassau), was the leader of the Dutch revolt against the Spanish Habsburgs that set off the Eighty Years' War (1568–1648) and resulted in the formal independence of the United Provinces in 1648.

zh.t: 沉默者威廉在荷兰代尔夫特的家中遭巴尔塔萨·热拉尔刺杀
zh.s: 沉默者威廉（荷兰语：Willem de Zwijger；1533年4月24日—1584年7月10日），在荷兰更常称为奥兰治的威廉（荷兰语：Willem van Oranje），在荷兰国歌中则称拿骚的威廉（荷兰语：Willem van Nassau）。他领导荷兰人反抗西班牙哈布斯堡王朝，由此引发八十年战争（1568—1648年），最终促成尼德兰联省于1648年正式独立。

en.s: The Battle of Veillane (or the Battle of Avigliana) was fought on 10 July 1630 between a French army under the command of Henri II de Montmorency and a Spanish army under the command of Don Carlo Doria. The result was a decisive French victory.

zh.s: 韦亚纳战役（又称阿维利亚纳战役）于1630年7月10日爆发，交战双方是亨利二世·德·蒙莫朗西指挥的法国军队和唐·卡洛·多利亚指挥的西班牙军队。法国军队取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Langport was a Parliamentarian victory late in the First English Civil War which destroyed the last Royalist field army and gave Parliament control of the West of England, which had hitherto been a major source of manpower, raw materials and imports for the Royalists. The battle took place on 10 July 1645 near the small town of Langport, which lies south of Bristol.

zh.s: 朗波特战役是第一次英国内战后期议会派的一场胜利，摧毁了保王派最后一支野战军，并使议会派控制了英格兰西部。此前，英格兰西部一直是保王派重要的人力、原材料和进口物资来源。战役于1645年7月10日在朗波特小镇附近爆发，该镇位于布里斯托尔以南。

en.s: The Battle of St Neots on 10 July 1648 was a skirmish during the Second English Civil War at St Neots in Cambridgeshire. A Royalist force led by the Earl of Holland and Colonel John Dalbier was defeated by 100 veteran troops from the New Model Army, commanded by Colonel Adrian Scrope.

zh.s: 圣尼奥茨战斗于1648年7月10日在剑桥郡圣尼奥茨爆发，是第二次英国内战期间的一场小规模交战。由霍兰伯爵和约翰·达尔比尔上校率领的保王派军队，被阿德里安·斯克罗普上校指挥的新模范军100名老兵击败。

en.s: The Battle of Berestechko (28 June – 10 July 1651) was fought between the Cossack Hetmanate and Crimean Khanate against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth as a part of the Khmelnytsky Uprising.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 别列斯捷奇科战役于1651年6月28日至7月10日爆发，是赫梅利尼茨基起义的一部分。交战双方是哥萨克酋长国和克里米亚汗国联军，以及波兰立陶宛联邦军队。

en.t: Henry Morgan's raid on Porto Bello
en.s: Henry Morgan's raid on Porto Bello was a military event which took place in the latter half of the Anglo-Spanish war beginning on 10 July 1668. Welsh buccaneer Henry Morgan led a largely English privateer force against the heavily fortified Spanish controlled town of Porto Bello (now Portobelo in modern Panama). After landing, Morgan and his men attempted to take the castles protecting the town.

zh.t: 亨利·摩根袭击波托韦洛
zh.s: 亨利·摩根袭击波托韦洛是英西战争后期的一次军事行动，于1668年7月10日开始。威尔士海盗亨利·摩根率领一支主要由英国人组成的私掠队，进攻由西班牙控制、设防严密的波托韦洛镇（今巴拿马的波托韦洛）。登陆后，摩根及其部下试图攻占守卫该镇的城堡。

en.s: The Battle of Beachy Head, also known as the Battle of Béveziers, was a fleet action fought on 10 July 1690 during the Nine Years' War. The battle was the most significant French naval victory over their Grand Alliance opponents during the war. The Dutch lost seven ships of the line and three fire ships. Their English allies also lost one ship of the line, whereas the French did not lose a single vessel.

zh.s: 比奇角海战也称贝韦济耶海战，于1690年7月10日九年战争期间爆发。这是法国在战争中对大同盟取得的最重要海上胜利。荷兰损失了7艘战列舰和3艘火船，盟友英国也损失了1艘战列舰；法国没有损失任何舰船。

en.s: The Battle of Corbach, or Korbach, a Hanseatic town of Waldeck-Frankenberg in northern Hesse, Germany, was fought on 10 July 1760 during the Seven Years' War. Corbach was the first battle of the campaign of 1760 and was a victory for the French over the Hanoverians, the British and their allies.

zh.s: 科尔巴赫（Korbach）战役于1760年7月10日七年战争期间爆发。科尔巴赫是德国黑森州北部瓦尔德克-弗兰肯贝格的一座汉萨城市。这是1760年战役的首场战斗，法国军队击败了汉诺威军队、英国军队及其盟友。

en.s: The Battle off Halifax took place on 10 July 1780 during the American Revolutionary War. The British privateer Resolution fought the American privateer Viper and heavy casualties were suffered by both sides. The battle was "one of the bloodiest battles in the history of privateering.... a loss of 51 lives in a single battle was virtually unheard of."

zh.s: 哈利法克斯海战于1780年7月10日美国独立战争期间爆发。英国私掠船“决心号”与美国私掠船“蝰蛇号”交战，双方伤亡惨重。有记载称，这“是私掠史上最血腥的战斗之一……单场战斗就有51人丧生，几乎闻所未闻”。

en.s: For the 1789 battle of Svensksund, see first Battle of Svensksund. The Battle of Svensksund (Finnish: Ruotsinsalmi, Russian: Rochensalm) was a naval battle fought in the Gulf of Finland outside the present day city of Kotka on 9 and 10 July 1790. The Swedish naval forces dealt the Russian fleet a devastating defeat that resulted in an end to the Russo-Swedish War of 1788–90. The battle is the biggest Swedish naval victory and the largest naval battle ever in the Baltic Sea.

zh.s: 1789年的斯文克松德战役另见“第一次斯文克松德战役”。斯文克松德海战（芬兰语：Ruotsinsalmi；俄语：Rochensalm）于1790年7月9日至10日在芬兰湾、今科特卡市外海爆发。瑞典海军重创俄罗斯舰队，结束了1788至1790年的俄瑞战争。这是瑞典海军取得的最大胜利，也是波罗的海历史上规模最大的海战。

en.s: The Battle of Błonie (Polish pronunciation: [ˈbwɔ.ɲɛ]; Polish: Bitwa pod Błoniem; German: Schlacht von Błonie) was fought on 10 July 1794, during the Kościuszko Uprising, near the town of Błonie, near the city of Warsaw, then a part of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, and now located within Poland. It was fought by the Polish–Lithuanian insurrectionist forces led by Stanisław Mokronowski againt the Prussian Army of the Kingdom of Prussia.

zh.s: 布沃涅战役（波兰语发音：[ˈbwɔ.ɲɛ]；波兰语：Bitwa pod Błoniem；德语：Schlacht von Błonie）于1794年7月10日科希丘什科起义期间爆发，地点在布沃涅镇附近，靠近华沙。当时该地属于波兰立陶宛联邦，如今位于波兰境内。斯坦尼斯瓦夫·莫克罗诺夫斯基率领的波兰立陶宛起义军与普鲁士王国军队交战。

en.s: The Battle of Padmanabha took place in Padmanabham, Visakhapatnam district (modern Andhra Pradesh, India), on 10 July 1794. This was a battle between King of Vizianagaram led by Vijayram Raj II and East India Company Madras Presidency Forces led by Colonel Pendargast under the command of British Governor of Madras, Sir Charles Oakly. The British emerged victoriously and the King was shot dead in the middle of battle.

zh.s: 帕德马纳巴姆战役于1794年7月10日在印度安得拉邦维沙卡帕特南县的帕德马纳巴姆爆发。交战双方是维济亚纳加拉姆国王维杰亚拉姆·拉吉二世率领的军队，以及由彭达加斯特上校指挥的东印度公司马德拉斯管区部队；彭达加斯特受马德拉斯总督查尔斯·奥克利爵士指挥。英国一方获胜，国王在战斗中中弹身亡。

en.s: The Battle of Kolno was fought on 10 July 1794 during the Kościuszko Uprising, between Polish–Lithuanian insurgents, led by Colonel Walenty Kwaśniewski, and Prussian Army led by General Heinrich Johann Günther. It took place in Kolno, in Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, now part of Poland, and ended without definitive victors, with both sides retreating.

zh.s: 科尔诺战役于1794年7月10日科希丘什科起义期间爆发。瓦伦蒂·克瓦希涅夫斯基上校率领的波兰立陶宛起义军与海因里希·约翰·金特尔将军率领的普鲁士军队交战。战斗发生在科尔诺，当时该地属于波兰立陶宛联邦，如今位于波兰境内。双方均撤退，没有明确的胜方。

en.s: The Battle of Rajgród (Polish: Bitwa pod Rajgrodem) was a battle of the Kościuszko Uprising between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth's insurrectionist army and the Kingdom of Prussia which took place in Rajgród on 1794 July 10. Polish insurrectionists using the melee weapons and without heavy artillery were able to temporarily push out the Prussian army from the city.

zh.s: 拉伊格鲁德战役（波兰语：Bitwa pod Rajgrodem）是科希丘什科起义期间波兰立陶宛联邦起义军与普鲁士王国军队之间的一场战斗，于1794年7月10日在拉伊格鲁德爆发。波兰起义军使用近战武器且没有重型火炮，但一度将普鲁士军队赶出城镇。

en.s: The Battle of Mukandwara Pass, also known as the Battle of Mokandra Pass or Monson's Retreat, was fought from 8 to 10 July 1804 between forces of the Indore Maharaja Yashwantrao Holkar, a member of the Maratha Confederacy and British East India Company forces under Colonel William Monson supported by Kotah kingdom during the Second Anglo-Maratha War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 穆坎德瓦拉山口战役也称莫坎德拉山口战役或蒙森撤退，于1804年7月8日至10日第二次英马拉塔战争期间爆发。交战双方是印度尔土邦大君亚什万特·拉奥·霍尔卡尔的军队，以及威廉·蒙森上校指挥的英国东印度公司军队；霍尔卡尔是马拉塔联盟成员，英军得到科塔王国支持。

en.s: The Vellore Mutiny, also known as the Vellore Rebellion or Vellore Revolt, occurred on 10 July 1806 and was the first instance of a large-scale and violent mutiny by Indian sepoys against the East India Company, predating the Indian Rebellion of 1857 by half a century. The revolt, which took place in the Indian city of Vellore, lasted one full day, during which mutineers seized the Vellore Fort and killed or wounded 200 British troops.

zh.s: 韦洛尔兵变也称韦洛尔起义，发生于1806年7月10日，是印度士兵首次大规模、暴力反抗东印度公司的兵变，比1857年印度起义早了半个世纪。兵变发生在印度韦洛尔市，持续整整一天。起义者占领韦洛尔堡，造成200名英国士兵死亡或受伤。

en.s: The Combat of Schöngrabern was a relatively minor rearguard action fought by Austrian V Korps and supporting elements of the Kaiserlich-königliche Hauptarmee under Prince Heinrich XV of Reuss-Plauen against elements of the French IV Corps of the Armée d'Allemagne, under the command of Claude Legrand. The brief combat ended in favour of the French but Reuss did manage to delay the French sufficiently in order to prevent them from getting to the battle of Znaim on 10 July.

zh.s: 舍恩格拉本交战是奥地利第五军团及帝国皇家主力军一部与法国德意志军团第四军之间的一场小规模后卫战，由罗伊斯-普劳恩亲王海因里希十五世和克洛德·勒格朗分别指挥。战斗以法军取胜告终，但罗伊斯仍成功拖住法军，使其未能赶上7月10日的兹奈姆战役。

en.s: In the Siege of Ciudad Rodrigo, the French Marshal Michel Ney took the fortified city from Field Marshal Don Andrés Perez de Herrasti on 10 July 1810 after a siege that began on 26 April. Ney's VI Corps made up part of a 65,000-strong army commanded by André Masséna, who was bent on a third French invasion of Portugal.

zh.s: 在罗德里戈城围城战中，法国元帅米歇尔·内伊于1810年7月10日攻占这座要塞城市，守将是唐·安德烈斯·佩雷斯·德·埃拉斯蒂元帅。围城始于4月26日。内伊的第六军团是安德烈·马塞纳指挥的6.5万大军的一部分；马塞纳正准备第三次入侵葡萄牙。

en.s: The Battle of Mir took place on 9 and 10 July 1812 during Napoleon's invasion of Russia. Three Polish Lancers divisions battled against Russian cavalry, ending in the first major Russian victory in the French invasion of Russia. Russian general Matvei Platov had eight Cossack regiments and two Don batteries deployed south of the village of Mir, when one brigade of the Polish Fourth Light Cavalry attacked his advance posts, numbering about 100 men. These advance posts had the dual job of both observation and sentry duty, and to entice the enemy to attack; ambushes of a hundred men each were set up farther down the road to Mir, on either side of it.

zh.s: 米尔战役于1812年7月9日至10日拿破仑入侵俄国期间爆发。三支波兰枪骑兵师与俄罗斯骑兵交战，最终俄军取得法国入侵俄国以来的首场重大胜利。俄罗斯将军马特维·普拉托夫在米尔村以南部署了8个哥萨克团和2个顿河炮兵连。波兰第四轻骑兵的一支旅随后袭击了他约100人的前哨。这些前哨既负责侦察和警戒，也负责诱敌来攻；俄军还在通往米尔的道路两侧更远处各设下由约100人组成的伏击队。

en.s: The Battle of La Plata was an action of the Colombian War of Independence fought on July 10, 1816, at and near the town of La Plata in the Neiva Province of New Granada (now Huila Department, Colombia). In this action the Spanish Army under the command of Lt. Colonel Carlos Tolrá defeated the remnants of the southern army of the Union under the command of President Liborio Mejía of the United Provinces of New Granada.

zh.s: 拉普拉塔战役是哥伦比亚独立战争期间的一场军事行动，于1816年7月10日在新格拉纳达的内瓦省拉普拉塔镇及其附近爆发，该地如今属于哥伦比亚乌伊拉省。卡洛斯·托尔拉中校指挥的西班牙军队击败了新格拉纳达联合省总统利博里奥·梅希亚指挥的联合省南方军残部。

en.s: The Laplace affair or the French Incident was a military intervention by the Kingdom of France in 1839 to end the persecution of Catholics in the Kingdom of Hawaii, which had been promoted by Protestant ministers. Under the threat of war, King Kamehameha III agreed to the French demands to stop the detention of Catholic citizens and pay reparations.

zh.s: 拉普拉斯事件又称法国事件，是1839年法国王国为制止夏威夷王国对天主教徒的迫害而进行的军事干预；迫害由新教牧师推动。在战争威胁下，卡美哈梅哈三世同意法国提出的要求，停止拘押天主教居民并支付赔偿。

en.s: The Battle of Ossa, one of many clashes of the January Uprising, took place on July 10, 1863, near the village of Ossa, which at that time belonged to Russian-controlled Congress Poland. An insurgent unit under Ludwik Zychlinski clashed with a detachment of the Imperial Russian Army. Polish forces numbered well over 1,000 men (200 zouaves, 300 riflemen, 600 kosynierzy and additional 200 insurgents who lacked any weapons). They camped at Ossa, and began their military exercises, when on July 10, 1863 at 6 p.m., were attacked by the Russians. The attack was fought off by the zouaves, who, with support of the kosynierzy, managed to break Russian positions.

zh.s: 奥萨战役是波兰一月起义期间多场冲突之一，于1863年7月10日在奥萨村附近爆发。当时该村属于俄国控制的波兰会议王国。路德维克·日赫林斯基率领的起义军与俄罗斯帝国军队一支分遣队交战。波兰军队人数超过1000人，包括200名祖阿夫轻步兵、300名步枪手、600名镰刀兵，以及另外200名没有武器的起义者。他们在奥萨扎营并开始训练，1863年7月10日下午6时遭俄军袭击。祖阿夫轻步兵在镰刀兵支援下击退进攻，并突破了俄军阵地。

en.s: The Second Battle of Funkstown (more commonly simply referred to as the Battle of Funkstown) took place near Funkstown, Maryland, on July 10, 1863, during the Gettysburg Campaign of the American Civil War. Union forces of the Army of the Potomac attacked the rear guard of the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia during its retreat from Pennsylvania following the Battle of Gettysburg. A strong Confederate presence at Funkstown threatened any Union advance against Gen. Robert E. zh.s: 第二次芬克斯敦战役通常简称芬克斯敦战役，于1863年7月10日在马里兰州芬克斯敦附近发生，是美国内战葛底斯堡战役的一部分。葛底斯堡战役后，波托马克联邦军袭击了正从宾夕法尼亚撤退的北弗吉尼亚邦联军后卫。芬克斯敦附近有大量邦联军驻守，威胁联邦军向罗伯特·E·李将军在威廉斯波特和波托马克河附近的阵地推进；李在葛底斯堡战役后正撤往弗吉尼亚。少将J·E·B……

en.s: The First Battle of Fort Wagner was fought on July 10 and 11, 1863, on Morris Island in Charleston harbor during the American Civil War. An attempt by the Union Army to capture Fort Wagner was repulsed. The more famous Second Battle of Fort Wagner, which involved an assault by the 54th Massachusetts, would be fought on July 18.

zh.s: 瓦格纳堡第一次战役于1863年7月10日至11日在查尔斯顿港的莫里斯岛爆发，是美国内战期间的一场战斗。联邦军试图攻占瓦格纳堡，但遭到击退。较为著名的瓦格纳堡第二次战役发生于7月18日，马萨诸塞州第54步兵团参与了进攻。

en.s: The Battle of Kissingen was a battle between Bavarian and Prussian troops on 10 July 1866 during the Austrian-Prussian War in and around the town of Kissingen (today: Bad Kissingen) in Bavaria. It was part of the campaign of the Main and ended with a victory of the Prussians.

zh.s: 基辛根战役于1866年7月10日普奥战争期间在巴伐利亚州基辛根镇及周边地区爆发；该镇如今名为巴特基辛根。交战双方是巴伐利亚和普鲁士军队。战役是美因河战役的一部分，最终由普鲁士获胜。

en.t: Peruvian and Chilean ships fight off Iquique
en.s: On July 10, 1879, the Peruvian ironclad Huáscar fought Chilean ships off Iquique during the War of the Pacific. Iquique is in present-day Chile.

zh.t: 秘鲁与智利军舰在伊基克外海交战
zh.s: 1879年7月10日，秘鲁铁甲舰“瓦斯卡尔”号与智利军舰在伊基克外海交战，这是南美太平洋战争的一场海战。伊基克如今属于智利。

en.s: The Battle of Concepción (Spanish: Batalla de Concepción) was fought on July 9 and July 10, 1882, during the Sierra Campaign of the War of the Pacific. Heavily outnumbered, the Chilean detachment of 77 men under the command of Lieutenant Ignacio Carrera Pinto was annihilated by a 1.300 Peruvian force, many of them armed with spears, commanded by Col.

zh.s: 康塞普西翁战役（西班牙语：Batalla de Concepción）于1882年7月9日至10日发生，是太平洋战争期间山地战役的一部分。伊格纳西奥·卡雷拉·平托中尉率领的77名智利分遣队寡不敌众，被由上校……指挥的1,300名秘鲁军队全歼；秘鲁军中许多人装备长矛。

en.s: The Battle of Huamachuco was fought on July 10, 1883, and it was the last major battle of the War of the Pacific. The Chilean soldiers led by Colonel Alejandro Gorostiaga decisively defeated the Peruvian army commanded by General Andrés Avelino Cáceres near the town of Huamachuco. This Chilean victory effectively eliminated Cáceres' Ejército de la Breña, ending any real threat or resistance in the Peruvian Andes. The Peruvian defeat paved the way for the Treaty of Ancon that finally put an end to the war. Also, one of Peru's greatest heroes, Colonel Leoncio Prado, died as a consequence of this battle.

zh.s: 瓦马丘科战役于1883年7月10日爆发，是太平洋战争的最后一场重大战役。亚历杭德罗·戈罗斯蒂亚加上校率领的智利军队在瓦马丘科镇附近决定性地击败了安德烈斯·阿韦利诺·卡塞雷斯将军指挥的秘鲁军队。智利的胜利实际上摧毁了卡塞雷斯的布雷尼亚军，结束了秘鲁安第斯地区真正的威胁和抵抗。秘鲁战败为签署最终结束战争的安孔条约铺平道路。秘鲁著名英雄之一莱昂西奥·普拉多上校也因这场战役而死。

en.s: Loretan Insurrection of 1896 was a rebellion of the population of the Department of Loreto against the government of Peru, fought from 2 May 1896 to 10 July 1896. During the insurrection, the population demanded federalization of Peru, and the reformation of Loreto into the autonomous state, which lead to self-proclamation of the Federal State of Loreto, a de facto autonomous region within Peru.

zh.s: 1896年洛雷托起义是秘鲁洛雷托省居民反抗政府的起义，持续时间为1896年5月2日至7月10日。起义期间，居民要求秘鲁实行联邦制，并将洛雷托改为自治州，随后宣布成立洛雷托联邦国，使该地区事实上成为秘鲁境内的自治区域。

en.s: The Battle of Motien Pass was a minor land battle of the Russo-Japanese War, fought between the Imperial Japanese Army under General Kuroki Tamemoto and the Imperial Russian Army under General Fyodor Eduardovich Keller over control of a strategic mountain pass on the main road between the coast and Liaoyang in Qing China on 10 July 1904.

zh.s: 摩天岭战役是日俄战争期间的一场小规模陆战，于1904年7月10日爆发。黑木为桢将军指挥的大日本帝国陆军与费奥多尔·爱德华多维奇·凯勒将军指挥的俄罗斯帝国陆军交战，争夺一处战略山口。该山口位于清朝中国境内，是连接海岸与辽阳的主要道路上的通道。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Echuca on 10 July 1907. This was triggered after the result at the 1906 election, which saw Anti-Socialist candidate Albert Palmer narrowly defeat Protectionist MP Thomas Kennedy, was declared void. Palmer was re-elected at the by-election.

en.s: General elections were held in Mexico on 26 June and 10 July 1910. The contested election instigated the beginning of the Mexican Revolution and preceded the end of the 35-year period of Mexican history known as the Porfiriato.

Contalmaison is a commune in the Somme department in Picardy in northern France. The village is 4 mi (6.4 km) north-east of Albert on the D 104, north-west of Mametz Wood and south of Pozières, at the junction of several roads, atop a spur with a good view in all directions.

en.s: The 1920 Ballaarat by-election was held on 10 July 1920 to elect the member for Ballaarat in the Australian House of Representatives. At the 1919 federal election, Nationalist candidate Edwin Kerby defeated the sitting Labor MP Charles McGrath by a single vote, the narrowest margin in Australian electoral history. McGrath challenged the result successfully on the grounds of electoral irregularities, triggering the by-election, at which McGrath was victorious.

zh.s: 1920年7月10日举行巴拉瑞特补选，选出澳大利亚众议院该选区的议员。1919年联邦选举中，国家党候选人埃德温·柯比以一票之差击败了在任工党议员查尔斯·麦格拉思，这是澳大利亚选举史上最小的胜差。麦格拉思以选举违规为由成功挑战选举结果，触发补选，并在补选中胜出。

en.t: Arthur Meighen becomes Prime Minister of Canada
en.s: Arthur Meighen ( MEE-ən; June 16, 1874 – August 5, 1960) was a Canadian lawyer and politician who served as the ninth prime minister of Canada from 1920 to 1921 and from June to September 1926. zh.t: 阿瑟·米恩就任加拿大总理

en.s: Bloody Sunday or Belfast's Bloody Sunday was a day of violence in Belfast, Northern Ireland on 10 July 1921, during the Irish War of Independence. The violence erupted one day before a truce began, which ended the war in most of Ireland. With the truce nearing, police launched a raid against republicans, but were ambushed by the Irish Republican Army (IRA) and an officer was killed.

zh.s: 血腥星期日（又称贝尔法斯特血腥星期日）是1921年7月10日发生在北爱尔兰贝尔法斯特的一场暴力事件，正值爱尔兰独立战争期间。停战协定即将生效，战争很快将在爱尔兰大部分地区结束。警方突袭共和派人士，遭爱尔兰共和军（IRA）伏击，一名警员被杀。

en.s: The State of Tennessee v. John Thomas Scopes, also known as the Scopes Monkey Trial, was an American legal case from July 10 to July 21, 1925, in which a high school teacher, John T. Scopes, was accused of violating the Butler Act, a Tennessee state law which outlawed the teaching of human evolution in public schools.
en.n: Scopes trial: In Dayton, Tennessee, the so-called "Monkey Trial" begins of John T. Scopes, a young high school science teacher accused of teaching evolution in violation of the Butler Act.

en.s: The Russian News Agency TASS, or simply TASS, is a Russian state-owned news agency founded in 1904. It is the largest Russian news agency and one of the largest news agencies worldwide. TASS is registered as a Federal State Unitary Enterprise, owned by the Government of Russia. Headquartered in Moscow, it has 70 offices in Russia and in the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS), "along with 56 global branches in 53 countries".

zh.s: 凯文·克里斯托弗·奥希金斯（爱尔兰语：Caoimhghín Críostóir Ó hUigín；1892年6月7日—1927年7月10日）是爱尔兰政治人物，1922年至1927年担任执行委员会副主席兼司法部长，1927年6月至7月担任外交部长，1922年1月至9月担任经济事务部长。他于1918年至1927年担任众议员（TD）。

en.t: World War II: The Vichy government is established in France
en.s: The Government of Vichy France was the collaborationist ruling regime or government in Nazi-occupied France during the Second World War. en.s: The Allied invasion of Sicily, also known as the Battle of Sicily and Operation Husky, was a major campaign of World War II in which Allied forces invaded the Italian island of Sicily in July 1943 and took it from the Axis forces. The island was defended by the Italian 6th Army and the German XIV Panzer Corps. The invasion paved the way for the Allied invasion of mainland Italy and initiated the Italian campaign that removed Italy from the war. With the conclusion of the North Africa campaign in May 1943, the victorious Allies had for the first time ejected the Axis powers from a theatre of war. Now at Italy's doorstep, the Allied powers—led by the United States and United Kingdom—decided to attack Axis forces in Europe via Italy, rather than Western Europe, due to the wavering Italian morale, control over Mediterranean sea lanes, and the vulnerability of German supply lines along the Italian Peninsula. To divert some Axis forces to other areas, the Allies engaged in deception operations, the most successful of which was Operation Mincemeat. Operation Husky began on the night of 9/10 July 1943 with a large amphibious and airborne operation, followed by a six-week land campaign that ended on 17 August.
en.n: This entry records the amphibious landings on 10 July 1943; airborne operations began during the preceding night.

zh.s: 盟军入侵西西里岛也称西西里战役或哈士奇行动，是第二次世界大战期间的一场重要战役。1943年7月，盟军攻入意大利的西西里岛，并从轴心国军队手中夺取该岛。岛上由意大利第6集团军和德国第14装甲军防守。这次入侵为盟军随后攻入意大利本土铺平道路，并开启了最终促使意大利退出战争的意大利战役。1943年5月北非战役结束后，获胜的盟军首次将轴心国势力逐出一个战区。当时盟军已抵达意大利门前，由美国和英国领导的盟军决定经由意大利而非西欧进攻欧洲的轴心国军队，原因包括意大利军心不稳、控制地中海航道的需要，以及德国沿亚平宁半岛补给线易受攻击。为调走部分轴心国军队，盟军开展了多项欺敌行动，其中最成功的是“肉馅行动”。哈士奇行动于1943年7月9日至10日夜间展开，先进行大规模两栖和空降行动，随后开展为期六周的陆上战役，并于8月17日结束。

en.s: The 1971 Moroccan coup attempt or the Skhirat coup d'état (Arabic: محاولة انقلاب الصخيرات, Skhirat attempted coup d'état) was an unsuccessful attempt by rebel military leaders to assassinate King Hassan II of Morocco on 10 July 1971, the day of his forty-second birthday. zh.s: “彩虹勇士号”沉没事件代号为“Opération Satanique”，是法国于1985年7月10日实施的一次国家恐怖主义行动。法国称，这是法国对外安全总局（DGSE）“行动”部门开展的“秘密行动”。行动中，两名法国特工在奥克兰港炸沉了绿色和平组织船队的旗舰“彩虹勇士号”。当时该船正准备前往穆鲁罗阿，抗议法国计划进行的核试验。

en.s: The International Cricket Council (ICC) is the global governing body of the sport of cricket. It was founded as the Imperial Cricket Conference on 15 June 1909 by the representatives of the Australian Cricket Board, England and Wales Cricket Board, and South African Cricket Association at Lord's. In 1965, the body was renamed as the International Cricket Conference and its current name was adopted in 1987.
en.n: The South African cricket team is readmitted into the International Cricket Council following the end of Apartheid.

zh.n: 种族隔离制度结束后，南非板球队获准重新加入国际板球理事会。

en.s: Boris Nikolayevich Yeltsin (1 February 1931 – 23 April 2007) was a Soviet and Russian politician who served as President of Russia from 1991 to 1999, having previously served as Chairman of the Supreme Soviet of the Russian SFSR from 1990 to 1991. en.s: The 1994 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final was a hurling match played on 10 July 1994 at Semple Stadium, Thurles, County Tipperary. It was contested by Limerick and Clare. Limerick, captained by Gary Kirby, won the game 0-25 to 2-10 to claim their first Munster title since 1981.

zh.t: 1994年芒斯特高级板棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1994年芒斯特高级板棍球锦标赛决赛于1994年7月10日在蒂珀雷里郡瑟尔斯的森普尔体育场举行，对阵双方是利默里克和克莱尔。加里·柯比担任队长的利默里克以0比25对2比10获胜，赢得自1981年以来首个芒斯特冠军。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Belarus on 23 June 1994, with a second round on 10 July. They were the first national elections held in Belarus since the country seceded from the Soviet Union three years earlier. The result was an overwhelming victory for Alexander Lukashenko, who received 81% of the vote in the second round. Voter turnout was 79% in the first round and 71% in the second.

zh.s: 白俄罗斯于1994年6月23日举行总统选举，并于7月10日举行第二轮投票。这是白俄罗斯脱离苏联三年后举行的首次全国选举。亚历山大·卢卡申科以压倒性优势胜出，在第二轮获得81%的选票。第一轮和第二轮投票率分别为79%和71%。

en.s: Early presidential elections were held in Ukraine on 26 June 1994, with a second round on 10 July. They were held ahead of schedule following a compromise between President Leonid Kravchuk and the Verkhovna Rada, the Ukrainian parliament. The elections saw Kravchuk defeated by his former Prime Minister Leonid Kuchma. They were the first presidential elections in the Commonwealth of Independent States in which the incumbent was defeated.

en.s: Operation Triangle I (Bosnian: Operacija Trokut I) was a military offensive conducted by the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina (ARBiH) in early July 1995, during the final months of the Bosnian War. The offensive was launched by the ARBiH 5th Corps in northwestern Bosnia, targeting Serb-held positions near Bosanska Otoka and Bosanska Krupa.

en.t: The NIOSH air filtration ratings update with the enactment of 42 CFR 84, previously published in the Federal Register. The new regulation includes rules governing the new N95 respirator standard
en.s: The NIOSH air filtration rating is the U.S. National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH)'s classification of filtering respirators. The ratings describe the ability of the device to protect the wearer from solid and liquid particulates in the air. The certification and approval process for respiratory protective devices is governed by Part 84 of Title 42 of the Code of Federal Regulations (42 CFR 84).

zh.t: 美国国家职业安全卫生研究所更新空气过滤等级，颁布此前已在《联邦公报》发布的42 CFR 84新规，其中纳入新的N95呼吸器标准
zh.s: NIOSH空气过滤等级是美国国家职业安全卫生研究所（NIOSH）对过滤式呼吸器的分类。这些等级说明设备保护佩戴者免受空气中固体和液体颗粒物影响的能力。呼吸防护设备的认证和批准程序由《联邦法规汇编》第42编第84部分（42 CFR 84）规定。

en.s: The final of the 1999 FIFA Women's World Cup was an association football match that took place on July 10, 1999, to determine the winner of the 1999 FIFA Women's World Cup. The host United States and China played to a scoreless draw. After extra time, the United States won the match with a 5-4 penalties victory. The match represented one of the most important events in the history of American athletics. It was played before over 90,000 fans in what remains the largest crowd ever to watch a women's sporting event.

zh.t: 1999年国际足联女子世界杯决赛
zh.s: 1999年国际足联女子世界杯决赛于1999年7月10日举行，决出该届赛事冠军。东道主美国队与中国队在常规时间和加时赛中均未进球，美国队随后以5比4赢得点球大战。此役是美国体育史上的重要赛事之一，现场观众超过9万人，至今仍是观看女子体育赛事人数最多的一场。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Syria on 10 July 2000, following the death of President Hafez al-Assad. The only candidate was his son, Bashar al-Assad, with voters asked to approve or reject his candidacy. A reported 99.7% of voters voted in favour, with a turnout of 94.6%. Political opposition to the president was not allowed.

zh.s: 哈菲兹·阿萨德总统去世后，叙利亚于2000年7月10日举行总统选举。唯一候选人是他的儿子巴沙尔·阿萨德，选民需要投票赞成或反对他参选。据报，99.7%的选民投票支持他，投票率为94.6%。当时不允许反对总统的政治活动。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Kyrgyzstan on 10 July 2005. The result was a landslide victory for acting President Kurmanbek Bakiyev, marking the end of his interim government formed after the previous president, Askar Akayev, was overthrown in the revolution in March 2005.

zh.s: 吉尔吉斯斯坦于2005年7月10日举行总统选举，代总统库尔曼别克·巴基耶夫以压倒性优势获胜。他的临时政府是在前总统阿斯卡尔·阿卡耶夫于2005年3月革命中被推翻后组建的；这次选举标志着临时政府任期结束。

en.s: Pakistan International Airlines Flight 688 was a domestic passenger flight from Multan to Islamabad with a stopover in Lahore, operated by Pakistan's flag carrier Pakistan International Airlines. All 41 passengers and four crew on board were killed.

zh.s: 巴基斯坦国际航空688号班机是一趟国内客运航班，由巴基斯坦国家航空公司巴基斯坦国际航空运营，从木尔坦飞往伊斯兰堡，中途经停拉合尔。2006年7月10日，执行该航线的一架福克F27客机从木尔坦国际机场起飞后不久，一台发动机失效，飞机坠入一片芒果园。机上41名乘客和4名机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: The 2008 Haltemprice and Howden by-election was a by-election held in the United Kingdom on 10 July 2008 to elect a new Member of Parliament (MP) for constituency of Haltemprice and Howden. The by-election was triggered by the surprise and controversial resignation from the House of Commons of the sitting MP David Davis on 12 June 2008. Davis stated intention was to spark a wider public debate on the perceived erosion of civil liberties in the UK by recontesting his seat on this single issue platform, launched as the David Davis for Freedom campaign.

zh.s: 哈尔滕普赖斯和霍登补选于2008年7月10日在英国举行，以选出该选区的新任下议院议员。时任议员戴维·戴维斯于2008年6月12日突然辞职，引发了这场颇具争议的补选。戴维斯表示，他希望以单一议题为竞选纲领重新竞选席位，借此引发公众对英国公民自由受到侵蚀的广泛讨论；他的竞选活动名为“戴维·戴维斯自由竞选”。

en.t: Acid-Fest: A Tribute to Trent Acid
en.s: Acid-Fest: A Tribute to Trent Acid was an interpromotional professional wrestling memorial event co-produced by the Combat Zone Wrestling (CZW) and Jersey All Pro Wrestling (JAPW) promotions, which took place on July 10, 2010, at the Viking Hall in South Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The show was held in honor of Trent Acid, one-half of the independent wrestling tag team The Backseat Boyz with Johnny Kashmere, who died of an accidental drug overdose at his home in Philadelphia less than a month before. It was the second such event held at the venue following the Pitbull/Public Enemy Memorial Cup, an event The Backseat Boyz had participated at, in 2006.

en.s: Destination X (2011) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) promotion, which took place on July 10, 2011 at the Impact Wrestling Zone in Orlando, Florida. Destination X was promoted with the tagline "Forward to the Past", as an all X Division event to commemorate the division that helped pave the way for the company long-term by bringing in popularity with its extraordinary athletic showcases. It was the seventh event under the Destination X chronology—first to be held in July—and the seventh event of the 2011 TNA PPV schedule.

zh.s: Destination X（2011年）是Total Nonstop Action Wrestling（TNA）主办的职业摔角付费收看赛事，于2011年7月10日在佛罗里达州奥兰多的Impact Wrestling Zone举行。赛事以“回到过去”为口号，全部比赛都属于X组别，旨在纪念这个凭借精彩竞技表演吸引人气、长期推动公司发展的组别。这是Destination X系列的第七场赛事，也是首次在7月举行；同时也是TNA 2011年付费赛事安排中的第七场。

en.t: Amid widespread backlash to revelations of phone hacking, the British weekly tabloid newspaper News of the World publishes its final issue and shuts down after nearly 168 years in print
en.s: The News of the World was a weekly national "red top" tabloid newspaper published every Sunday in the United Kingdom from 1843 to 2011. It was at one time the world's highest-selling English-language newspaper and at closure still had one of the highest English-language circulations. It was established as a broadsheet by John Browne Bell, who identified crime, sensation, and vice as the themes that would sell most copies.

zh.s: 《世界新闻报》是英国一份全国性周刊“小报”，从1843年至2011年每周日出版。它曾是全球销量最高的英文报纸，停刊时仍是发行量最高的英文报纸之一。该报由约翰·布朗·贝尔创办，最初以大报形式发行；贝尔认为，犯罪、轰动事件和恶行最能吸引读者购买。

en.t: Russian cruise ship Bulgaria sinks in the Volga River near Syukeyevo, Tatarstan, causing 122 deaths
en.s: Bulgaria (Russian: Булга́рия, romanized: Bulgariya) was a class 785/OL800 Russian river cruise ship (built in Komárno, Czechoslovakia) which operated in the Volga-Don basin. On 10 July 2011, Bulgaria sank in the Kuybyshev Reservoir of the Volga River near Syukeyevo, Kamsko-Ustyinsky District, Tatarstan, Russia, with 201 passengers and crew aboard when sailing from the town of Bolgar to the regional capital, Kazan.

en.s: The 2016 Kagoshima Prefecture gubernatorial election was held on 10 July 2016 and contested by the three-term incumbent Yuichiro Ito and political journalist Satoshi Mitazono. Ito was denied a fourth term in office, as Mitazono received 55% of the vote following a campaign based primarily on change as well as opposition to the prefecutre's operating nuclear power plant. The election was held on the same day as the national House of Councillors election, which helped increase voter turnout to 58.6%, compared to 43.8% at the previous election in 2012.

zh.s: 2016年鹿儿岛县知事选举于2016年7月10日举行，候选人包括寻求连任、已任三届的知事伊藤祐一郎，以及政治记者三反园训。三反园以55%的得票率胜出，伊藤未能获得第四个任期。三反园的竞选重点是带来改变，并反对县内核电站继续运行。该选举与日本全国参议院选举在同一天举行，投票率升至58.6%，高于2012年上次选举的43.8%。

en.s: The UEFA Euro 2016 Final was a football match that took place on 10 July 2016 at the Stade de France in Saint-Denis, France, to determine the winners of UEFA Euro 2016. zh.s: Battle Riot III是美国职业摔角联盟（MLW）主办的职业摔角赛事，于2021年7月10日在宾夕法尼亚州费城的2300竞技场举行。这是MLW因新冠疫情停办赛事后，首次允许购票观众现场观看的活动；此前最后一场有观众的赛事是2020年的MLW对阵AAA超级系列赛。这是Battle Riot系列的第三场赛事。

en.s: The 2021 Copa América final was a football match to determine the winners of the 2021 Copa América. The match was the 47th final of the Copa América, a quadrennial tournament contested by the men's national teams of the member associations of CONMEBOL. The match was held at Estádio do Maracanã in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil on 10 July 2021.

en.s: The 2020 All-Ireland Under-20 Hurling Championship final was a hurling match that was played at UPMC Nowlan Park, Kilkenny on 10 July 2021 to determine the winners of the 2020 All-Ireland Under-20 Hurling Championship, the 57th season of the All-Ireland Under-20 Hurling Championship, a tournament organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the champion teams of Leinster and Munster.

zh.s: 2020年全爱尔兰20岁以下板棍球锦标赛决赛于2021年7月10日在基尔肯尼的UPMC诺兰公园举行，决出2020年该项赛事冠军。这是全爱尔兰20岁以下板棍球锦标赛的第57个赛季。赛事由盖尔运动协会主办，参赛者是伦斯特和芒斯特的冠军队。

en.s: The 2021 Supercupa României was the 23rd edition of the Supercupa României, an annual football super cup contested by the winners of the previous season's Liga I and Cupa României competitions. The game featured CFR Cluj and Universitatea Craiova, with the Arena Națională in Bucharest hosting the competition for the first time since 2014. Universitatea Craiova claimed its first Supercup after a 4–2 victory at the penalty shoot-out.

zh.s: 2021年罗马尼亚超级杯是该赛事第23届比赛。这项年度足球超级杯由上赛季罗马尼亚甲级联赛和罗马尼亚杯的冠军参加，对阵双方为克卢日足球俱乐部和克拉约瓦大学队。布加勒斯特国家竞技场自2014年以来首次承办该赛事。克拉约瓦大学队在点球大战中以4比2获胜，首次夺得超级杯。

en.s: House of Councillors elections were held in Japan on 10 July 2022 to elect 125 of the 248 members of the upper house of the National Diet, for a term of six years. en.s: The 2024 Iraq FA Cup final was the 31st final of the Iraq FA Cup as a club competition. The match was contested between Al-Shorta and Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya, at Al-Shaab Stadium in Baghdad.
